about_the_game:
From the creator of... absolutely nothing else so far...
...comes the latest confusing mess of a game.

Athyra takes the simplest game everyone knows—Rock, Paper, Scissors—and turns it into the most complicated horror experience that not many understand (including maybe the developer).

Face off against unsettling opponents, solve cryptic puzzles, and try not to question your sanity—or the rules. Because yes, there are rules. Probably. Somewhere.

Also, it’s a horror game.



In Athyra, you will...

  • Face off against twisted, unsettling opponents in the simplest game you've ever known... or thought you knew.

  • Uncover cryptic puzzles and unsettling lore as you venture deeper into the trial.

  • Explore rooms full of horrors, all linked by a bizarre, unnerving connection.

  • Question everything... including the game itself.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains the following content that may not be appropriate for all ages:

Violence: Includes shooting animations and depictions of blood.

Horror Elements: Contains sudden loud noises, jump scares, and disturbing imagery.

short_description: Athyra takes Rock, Paper, Scissors and turns it into a psychological horror trial full of puzzles, jumpscares, and cryptic lore. Inspired by Inscryption and Buckshot Roulette, Athyra pits you against disturbing foes in deadly games of Rock, Paper, Scissors...
